steps.text:
The headphone hook is built as a single part with its two countersunk M4 screw holes. It is not sliced or sent to the printer yet.

It has a 60 x 30 x 4 mm mount plate, with the hook dropping 35 mm below it from the front edge. The hook is 30 mm wide, with an 8 mm stem and arm, a 30 mm projection, and 10 mm rounded tip corners. The two 4.5 mm clearance holes are 40 mm apart, with 8 mm, 90-degree countersinks on the underside of the plate, so the screw heads sit below the plate and the screws drive up into the desk. The part checks clean: watertight, with 2.25 mm minimum wall.

Only the 4.5 mm clearance is a sourced value (M4 clearance chart). The plate size, hook dimensions, countersink head and angle are my guesses, so check them against your desk edge and screws. Next I can orient the part for printing (the hook arm will need support), then slice it on your P1S with PLA. Tell me if you want that.
